```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(nlme)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)

options(scipen = 999)

# Fixed-effect table for nlme::lme models.
print_lme_fixed <- function(model, digits = 3) {
  tt <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$tTable)
  tt$Parameter <- rownames(tt)
  rownames(tt) <- NULL

  crit <- qt(0.975, df = tt$DF)
  tt$CI_low <- tt$Value - crit * tt$Std.Error
  tt$CI_high <- tt$Value + crit * tt$Std.Error

  p_fmt <- ifelse(
    is.na(tt$`p-value`),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(
      tt$`p-value` < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      formatC(tt$`p-value`, format = "f", digits = digits)
    )
  )

  out <- data.frame(
    Parameter = tt$Parameter,
    Estimate = round(tt$Value, digits),
    SE = round(tt$Std.Error, digits),
    `95% CI` = sprintf(
      paste0("%.", digits, "f to %.", digits, "f"),
      tt$CI_low, tt$CI_high
    ),
    DF = tt$DF,
    `t value` = round(tt$`t-value`, digits),
    `p value` = p_fmt,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  print(knitr::kable(out, align = c("l", "r", "r", "c", "r", "r", "r")))
}

model_n_by_quintile <- function(model, data, id = "pat.id", quintile = "tmao_q",
                                extra_vars = character()) {
  vars <- unique(c(all.vars(formula(model)), id, quintile, extra_vars))
  vars <- vars[vars %in% names(data)]

  used <- data %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

  used %>%
    group_by(.data[[quintile]]) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n_distinct(.data[[id]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

print_model_set <- function(models) {
  for (nm in names(models)) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
    print_lme_fixed(models[[nm]])
  }
}

print_model_n_set <- function(models, data, extra_vars = character()) {
  out <- bind_rows(lapply(names(models), function(nm) {
    model_n_by_quintile(
      models[[nm]],
      data = data,
      extra_vars = extra_vars
    ) %>%
      mutate(Model = nm, .before = 1)
  }))

  print(knitr::kable(
    out,
    col.names = c("Model", "TMAO quintile", "N")
  ))
}

```

# Data preparation

```{r data-preparation, results='asis'}
# follow-up, subgroup, or sensitivity-analysis datasets.
baseline_raw <- read_csv("Baseline.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

baseline_tmao <- baseline_raw %>%
  transmute(
    pat.id = as.character(pat.id),
    tmao_q = as.factor(tmao_q)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

if (anyDuplicated(baseline_tmao$pat.id)) {
  stop("Baseline.csv contains more than one TMAO-quintile value for at least one pat.id.")
}

attach_baseline_tmao_q <- function(data, baseline_lookup = baseline_tmao) {
  data %>%
    mutate(pat.id = as.character(pat.id)) %>%
    select(-any_of("tmao_q")) %>%
    left_join(baseline_lookup, by = "pat.id")
}

check_tmao_q_fixed <- function(data, dataset_name = deparse(substitute(data))) {
  changing <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(tmao_q)) %>%
    group_by(pat.id) %>%
    summarise(n_tmao_q = n_distinct(tmao_q), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_tmao_q > 1)

  if (nrow(changing) > 0) {
    stop(dataset_name, ": tmao_q is not fixed within participant.")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# Baseline quintile counts used in the manuscript cohort.
baseline_tmao %>%
  count(tmao_q, name = "N") %>%
  knitr::kable()


dd <- baseline_raw %>%
  mutate(
    pat.id = as.character(pat.id),
    tmao_q = as.factor(tmao_q),
    tmao_log = log1p(tmao)
  )

check_tmao_q_fixed(dd, "Baseline.csv")
```

# Descriptive NfL distribution by baseline TMAO quintile

```{r nfl-description, results='asis'}
nfl_summary <- dd %>%
  filter(!is.na(tmao_q), !is.na(nfl)) %>%
  group_by(tmao_q) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(pat.id),
    mean = mean(nfl),
    sd = sd(nfl),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(nfl_summary)
```

```{r nfl-boxplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(dd %>% filter(!is.na(tmao_q), !is.na(nfl)),
       aes(x = tmao_q, y = nfl, fill = tmao_q)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Baseline TMAO quintile",
    y = "Neurofilament light polypeptide",
    title = "NfL according to baseline TMAO quintile"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd") +
  ylim(0, 200) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# Association between TMAO and NfL

- **Model 1:** age, sex.
- **Model 2:** Model 1 + BMI, hypertension.
- **Model 3:** Model 2 + coronary artery disease, previous stroke/TIA.
- **Model 4a:** Model 3 + eGFR.
- **Model 4b:** Model 3 + diabetes.
- **Model 5:** Model 3 + diabetes + eGFR.

```{r model-specification}
nfl_covariates <- list(
  "Model 1" = c("age.bl", "pat.sex"),
  "Model 2" = c("age.bl", "pat.sex", "bmi", "prev.hypertonie"),
  "Model 3" = c(
    "age.bl", "pat.sex", "bmi", "prev.hypertonie",
    "prev.coronary.heart.disease", "prev.stroke.tia"
  ),
  "Model 4a" = c(
    "age.bl", "pat.sex", "bmi", "prev.hypertonie",
    "prev.coronary.heart.disease", "prev.stroke.tia", "creatinine.gfr"
  ),
  "Model 4b" = c(
    "age.bl", "pat.sex", "bmi", "prev.hypertonie",
    "prev.coronary.heart.disease", "prev.stroke.tia", "prev.diabetes"
  ),
  "Model 5" = c(
    "age.bl", "pat.sex", "bmi", "prev.hypertonie",
    "prev.coronary.heart.disease", "prev.stroke.tia",
    "prev.diabetes", "creatinine.gfr"
  )
)

build_nfl_formula <- function(exposure, covariates) {
  as.formula(
    paste("nfl ~", paste(c(exposure, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  )
}

fit_nfl_set <- function(exposure, data = dd) {
  setNames(lapply(names(nfl_covariates), function(nm) {
    nlme::lme(
      fixed = build_nfl_formula(exposure, nfl_covariates[[nm]]),
      random = ~ 1 | center,
      data = data,
      na.action = na.exclude
    )
  }), names(nfl_covariates))
}
```

## TMAO quintiles

```{r nfl-quintile, results='asis'}
nfl_q <- fit_nfl_set("tmao_q")
print_model_set(nfl_q)
cat("\n\n### Analysis N by baseline TMAO quintile\n\n")
print_model_n_set(nfl_q, dd, extra_vars = "center")
```

## TMAO continuous

```{r nfl-continuous, results='asis'}
nfl_cont <- fit_nfl_set("tmao_log")
print_model_set(nfl_cont)
cat("\n\n### Analysis N by baseline TMAO quintile\n\n")
print_model_n_set(nfl_cont, dd, extra_vars = "center")
```

## One diagnostic plot for NfL

```{r nfl-autoplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
nfl_diag_lm <- lm(
  formula = build_nfl_formula("tmao_q", nfl_covariates[["Model 5"]]),
  data = dd,
  na.action = na.exclude
)

autoplot(nfl_diag_lm, which = c(1, 2, 3, 5), ncol = 2)
```
